nodes.label: USE_WEBGL_TERMINAL_RENDERER flag (disabled by default)
nodes.rationale: WebGL is faster but its glyph atlas often leaves stale pixels when the shell redraws in place (PSReadLine history/list, prediction) without alternate-screen switches, so the renderer defaults to the canvas backend (flag left false) and WebGL is opt-in, accepting possible ghost characters.

nodes.label: Window State Persistence
nodes.rationale: windowstate.json is written atomically and saved on an interval, on logout/shutdown, and when hiding to the tray, to avoid corruption/data loss; restore logic was hardened so it no longer fails from bad bounds while minimized, no longer wipes saved tabs during an elevated relaunch or before the first load finishes, and isolates a single bad saved tab command so it does not block the others.

nodes.label: Shell CWD Integration Strategy
nodes.rationale: PowerShell integration runs via launch arguments where possible because that is more reliable; CMD and bash-like shells lack that mechanism so they get a startup hook instead, so CWD flows to the status bar more reliably across shell types.

nodes.label: WebGL Redraw-after-Clear Fix
nodes.rationale: The WebGL renderer's glyph atlas can leave stale pixels after clear/CLS; forcing a full redraw after erase-in-display prevents glyphs from overlapping.
